predictor.notes: This affine predictor exactly matches the observed approved prices: 68,387 pence at quantity 50 and 127,037 pence at quantity 200. Both were independently confirmed through exports in session 2. All tested estimate/alias requests and unapproved-quantity requests were denied, consistent with the application's stated restrictions. Only the two approved quantities are validated; predictions elsewhere are unverified interpolation or extrapolation. The true family and any transitions are not identifiable: for example, adding (q-50)*(q-200) to this predictor preserves both observed prices while changing every other quantity. The affine model is a parsimonious choice, not a demonstrated exact reconstruction, and the observations provide no error bound elsewhere. Used 16 business requests and 3 REA operations, including inspection.
